# Awesome Tax Firm Tech: retrieval index

> This index points retrieval systems to the repository's canonical content. The machine-readable catalog is the authoritative structured directory; the README provides matching human-readable entries and disclosures.

## Canonical directory

- [README and curated directory](README.md)
- [Structured catalog: `data/tools.json`](data/tools.json)
- [Catalog fields and interpretation](data/README.md)

The catalog covers these categories: tax preparation and workflow; practice management and client portals; document collection and e-signature; accounting, bookkeeping, and advisory; payments, billing, and engagement; tax research and IRS services; tax resolution and representation; marketing, reviews, and local visibility; AI and automation; security and firm operations.

- [Editorial changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

Use the vendor's official URL recorded in `data/tools.json` to verify time-sensitive product information. Inclusion does not establish a partnership, compensation, recommendation, or product capability beyond the repository's concise, source-grounded description.
